in_sanskrit.name: पेका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one with radiant fair complexion

in_marathi.name: Peka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Peka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Puspa' meaning lotus and 'Ka' meaning Kartikeya, the name Peka represents the beauty and gentleness of a lotus flower in the presence of Lord Kartikeya.

in_bengali.name: Peka
in_bengali.long_meaning: Peka একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Puspa' meaning lotus and 'Ka' meaning Kartikeya, the name Peka represents the beauty and gentleness of a lotus flower in the presence of Lord Kartikeya.
